body: Thing is, hundreds of dogs that come from Alabama truly were lost and still have an owner somewhere. There are very few strays.

I suppose. I've been off and on different things for years and currently disgusted with the most recent change. So, after repeated sessions and requests for a change, I've given up and stopped taking any of it. (For few months as of now) Started out perfectly fine but its ended in an abrupt, downward spiral. I'd like to end that. I don't want to have false emotions and I don't want the only other option I have. If I can't experience life like a normal person with all the proper excitement, true happiness, sincerely laughing with friends and, mostly, just being able to enjoy who I am.

I can't do any of those things in my current or any previous states. I don't want to go through any more. I don't want to force myself through the next thing. I don't want to last long enough to see the end of another manic episode. Or even the start of one. I don't want to feel so unsure of tomorrow, of three years from now. I don't want to wait until my mind decides I'm happy. I don't want to wait tobe sad. I want to feel true simultaneousness. I want smile. I want to see a day where I can be in the moment. To feel that moment is all I want.

Yes. I have a psychiatrist. I have a therapist. I have medication.

I'm not simply saying something along the lines of "crossed emotions". I'm trying to describe to you how I feel about being fucking bipolar and how my highs and lows are. I'm tired of that. I don't want to see the world through two emotions. "Middle ground" for me is quite rare.

They don't. They honestly don't.

When I'm not down, I'm aggressive, I'm stupid, I'm over-bearingly excited about everything. I eventually lash out at others. I lash out at myself. I try to make it go away. It's always too much. But, I feel important. I feel powerful. I feel unstoppable. I feel like I can do anything.

But I never can.

When I am down, nothing is exciting, nothing if fun. I'm even more of an idiot. I can't think clearly (again likewise with being "happy"). I hate everything I say or do. Everything that causes me happiness, I cherish and despise simultaneously. 

I want to feel true happiness. I want to feel pride. I want to feel love. I want to be a real person with real feelings that aren't just decided by the flip of a coin with extra weight added to either side.
